# Startup Cookie
> AI-native content & GTM agency for B2B SaaS startups (also written "StartupCookie"). Founded and run by Barbara Jovanovic. One person, maximum six clients at a time, month-to-month programs from $5,000/mo. Next client opening: November 13th.

Startup Cookie runs product marketing and product-led growth (PLG) content, thought leadership, founder LinkedIn, AEO (AI search optimization), video content, webinar repurposing, and custom GTM/content agents for seed-to-Series-B B2B SaaS companies. Founder Barbara Jovanovic runs every engagement herself; custom AI agents handle the production work. Her appearance on HubSpot's Marketing Against the Grain is the most-watched episode in the show's history (164k+ views).
